verify_shortest_path_dataset: run the python script to verify all JPG files in a shortest path dataset directory
view_random_sequence: run the python script to view a random sequence of images as an MP4 video
verify_dataset_integrity: run the verify function to open and count all JPG files in nested dataset folders
export_images_to_video: run the view function to export a random image sequence to an MP4 video file
parse_verify_args: run the get_args function to parse command line arguments for dataset verification and viewing
